title: foreman CLI prints nothing and sets no exit code when run from PowerShell
body: Installed foreman.exe (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\foreman) run from pwsh inside a foreman Session: 'kanban integrate/wait/list' print no stdout and $LASTEXITCODE is empty (the commands do run: integrate queued the card). The same calls via bash print output and return exit codes. Likely a GUI-subsystem exe that PowerShell doesn't wait on or attach stdio to. This breaks the worker close-out (kanban wait exit codes) and the foreman-kanban skill's PowerShell examples. Seen 2026-09-24 on card l8th0t.
